svg.title: Héliotrope — an illustrative Heliotropium-like specimen
svg.desc: An illustrative heliotrope for the broad historical calendar name, without claiming an exact species: a softly hairy branching sage-green stem bears wrinkled oval leaves with a rough network of veins. Three narrow, curling scorpioid flower sprays carry many tiny cream and pale lilac five-lobed flowers with yellowish throats, followed by round unopened buds at the inward-curled tips.
